name: The Cross Keys and the old chapel

layers.essential_history: [[c:The Cross Keys stands on the old road near the post office. Nearby is a former chapel, now a private house.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Wansford was split between two counties until 1965.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:A stable lad says Ned the guard asked him how deep the water is under the bridge, 'just out of interest'.]]

directions_to_next: [[c:Turn left along the lane past the Cross Keys and follow the footpath round the fields, coming back out onto Elton Road further south. Turn right, walk back up Elton Road and Bridge End to the Old Bridge. About 1.1 km.]]
